text:
ari: heads-up — canary for checkout-service chart v1.8.0 failed in sa-east-1, post-upgrade hook complaining about missing secret :grimacing:
deploy-bot: canary failure detected: checkout-service v1.8.0 -> post-upgrade hook: Secret "checkout/stripe-key" not found
ben: preflight passed (schema + lints) but our region-sync lambda never applied secrets to sa-east-1 cluster.
chloe: product said avoid rolling back because v1.8.0 includes a small migration. rollback could leave partial state for customers.
ari: options:
 - manual restore of secret from vault + re-run canary (preferred)
 - quick values override to use literal (risky & messy)
 - rollback region (last resort)
oncall: I can pull the key from vault and apply in-cluster now. Command:
VAULT_ADDR=https://vault.internal vault kv get -field=token secret/checkout/sa-east | kubectl -n checkout create secret generic stripe-key --from-literal=apiKey=$(cat -) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
then: kubectl -n checkout rollout restart deploy/checkout-service
ben: applying hold on all sa-* promotions until we confirm canary. release-manager: hold applied, notifying docs & SRE.
oncall: secret applied, pods restarted, mounts look healthy.
deploy-bot: canary health checks passed in sa-east-1 for checkout-service v1.8.0 :white_check_mark:
release-manager: resume promotions but add 15m gap between regions. Add a short release-note: "sa-east required emergency secret restore during rollout".
chloe: filing follow-ups: GH #4801 add secret-exists preflight, GH #4802 console alert on missing secretRefs, GH #4803 region-sync reliability runbook.
ari: pin edgezone pipeline to v1.8.0 for 24h to avoid mixed versions.
oncall: note for oncall team: prefer secret restore + recheck over rollback unless migration fails. If migration shows errors, escalate and consider rollback.
release-manager: removing hold. closing thread and tracking GH actions. :white_check_mark:
